description: groundwater flow structures + the Darcy law, for cross-field synthesis against the heat equation

structures.definition: a porous reservoir whose water mass is conserved (recharge = discharge + storage change)
groundwater head h obeys S ∂h/∂t = ∇·(K ∇h) (the confined-aquifer flow equation)

properties.statement: specific discharge q is proportional to the hydraulic gradient: q = −K ∇h

evidence.what: drawdown follows the Theis curve (diffusive scaling of head in time)

mappings.mapping: the confined-aquifer flow equation S ∂h/∂t = ∇·(K ∇h) is the heat equation with diffusivity K/S
